name: paper-polisher-pro
description: AI writing detector (author self-check) + academic polishing guidance + terminology protection, 100% local. 11-layer recalibrated rule engine + token-spectrum layer + length-routed fusion + optional supervised Qwen3-0.6B ONNX layer (AUROC 1.0 held-out) + LLM fingerprint attribution (GLM/DeepSeek/Qwen/Kimi/MiniMax/GPT/Claude/Gemini) + journal precheck + AIGC compliance label check + paragraph attribution. Eval-driven: base-engine numbers reproduce via the bundled held-out evaluation; supervised-layer figures are author-side held-out measurements.
author: DoctorQ Lab
changelog: v3.10.0: fingerprint freshness phase 3 — 135 fresh samples across four current-generation families; kimi-k2.7 registered (zero-FP pattern, Kimi-family attribution verified); topic-word and cross-family contaminated candidates rolled back per quality gate; glm-5.3 refreshed. Registry: 13 families. Sampling+mining via OpenCode Go channel; held-out AUROC unchanged 0.9022. v3.9.0: discourse smoothness disclosure — new surprisal-variation layer (DivEye-inspired windowed-lift CV; held-out AUROC 0.8256 standalone, detection 66/146@6, human FPR 1/14) surfaced as report evidence, NOT fused into the score per the reproducible-numbers iron law; coverage guard 0.35 + evidence discount; run_eval gains --layer mode for reproducible per-layer metric cards. v3.8.0: mixed-register signal (mixed_signal + per-paragraph guidance), register hint, encoding warning, gate layer-divergence disclosure — honest-boundary guardrails aligned with mixed-document and paraphrase-robustness research directions. v3.7.0: discourse-structure heuristic layer (L12, 8 groups, density-scaled cap 30; LES-20260923-021 blind-spot fix; held-out AUROC 0.9022 unchanged); fingerprint freshness 2026-09-23 (kimi-k3 registered via OpenCode Go sampling, attribution-verified; qwen3.8/deepseek-v4 sampled pending quality-pass; registry freshness visible in pp_doctor); centralized FAQ (10 answers), script cheat sheet, clearer edge-case errors, scanner-surface hardening. v3.6.0: academic-integrity guardrails (integrity_notice, Academic Integrity section); CH-side wording cleanup. (Encoding hardening & deai_gate fallback loop shipped in v3.5.0.) v3.5.0: degraded-mode disclosure, iron law #2 (<100 chars -> risk=unknown), pp_doctor self-check, deai_gate fallback loop. v3.4.x: supervised layer + edit-regression v2 (human FPR@p99 0.71%, attack recall 86.6%), language gating. v3.0.0: eval-driven rebuild (AUROC 0.7046->0.9187 held-out).
